verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official CLI as part of its SDK docs ('Use the Datalab CLI to convert documents from the command line'), and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. The evidence is thin beyond that one line: only document conversion is shown as a CLI capability. missing for 10: evidence of CLI coverage for extraction/pipelines/segmentation, agent-friendly details (machine-readable output, scripting/auth flags), independent or hands-on corroboration.
